_comment: pa11y runs the HTML CodeSniffer (htmlcs) engine here. axe-core is run separately and more rigorously by the Playwright suite (tests/e2e/a11y.spec.js) in BOTH colour schemes, so the two engines together cover every page. pa11y's own axe runner is intentionally not used: it cannot read gradient backgrounds (marking them contrast-incomplete) and offers no colour-scheme control, producing false positives on the design's gradient bands.
